title: Klein planted-truth benchmark submission
description: One arm's frozen, machine-readable answer to a planted-truth benchmark. The custodian imports this file with `klein generation benchmark submit --arm <id> --file <path>` before any reveal. Klein depends on no JSON Schema library: kleinlib.generation.benchmark.submission_problems enforces exactly these rules in plain Python, and this document is the participant-facing statement of them. The custodian hashes whichever copy is in the study at commit time, so the version in force is on the record.

study.description: The PARTICIPANT study's id — the workspace that produced this answer, which is never the custodian's study.

arm.description: The arm id, as declared in the custodian's benchmark.yaml. It must equal the --arm the custodian imports it under.

structures.description: The ranked structures the arm claims to have recovered. At most benchmark.yaml's hypothesis_cap entries: the cap is what stops an arm from listing every possible interaction and calling one of them a discovery.

rank.description: 1 is the arm's best answer. Ranks are unique inside one submission; recovery is scored in rank order, so the best-ranked structure that matches a planted truth is the one that claims it.

variables.description: The variables the structure is over. Matched as a SET under matching_rule.variables: exact.

relationship.description: The relationship claimed, e.g. interaction, main, monotone, threshold. Matched as a string under matching_rule.relationship: exact.

direction.description: The sign of the effect. Matched under matching_rule.direction: sign.

context.description: Where the structure is claimed to hold, in the arm's own words. Adjudicated by the custodian against the preregistered matching_rule.context sentence and recorded per row as the pinned table's context_ok column — this dimension is judgement, and it is labelled as judgement rather than folded into the arithmetic.

h_ids.description: The participant's own hypothesis ids that led to this structure. An empty list means the arm recorded no hypothesis provenance, which is a fact about the arm rather than an error.

support.description: Optional: a study-relative path, run id or command in the PARTICIPANT's study that reproduces the executable analysis supporting this structure. The custodian does not execute it; it is what an adjudicator reads when the context condition is contested.
